name: Villajoyosa (Spain)
description: Four red bars on yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of La Vila Joiosa (a ship, a tower and the Senyera on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Villajoyosa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: La Vila Joiosa arms — ship, tower and Senyera on blue
